newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE CASH MAIZE UP AFTER USDA DATA.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE CASH MAIZE UP AFTER USDA DATA.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed up sharply at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Tuesday as it followed U.S. markets to higher ground on bullish USDA crop data, traders said.

FAS elevator maize rose $5 to $106 for delivery to Buenos Aires, in moderate volume trade. FAS elevator soybeans were unchanged at $270 for delivery to Rosario in thin trade, with market attention focussed on maize. FAS elevator sunflower soybeans gained $2 to $220 for deliver to Rosario, in thin trade.
